headline: Tell me what's broken without leaving Premiere.
notes: **Submit feedback**, in the ☰ menu. Type it, press Send, done — no email app, no copying version numbers by hand.
**Help**, in the ☰ menu, opens the new documentation with a guide to every button.
Tips & tour is four steps instead of six, and set larger so it can actually be read.
Fixed: the panel stopped resizing its buttons with the window.
Fixed: choosing a tour step or a feedback type left the button looking unpressed.
